caveats: NOT A CURRENT SCREEN CANDIDATE — assembled because the name carries an operator follow decision — Plaque-psoriasis biotech followed under the QUALITY book, accepted by the operator 2026-09-10. One drug leads: ORKA-001, an IL-23p19 antibody engineered for a long half-life. In the EVERLAST-A Phase 2a (announced 2026-04-27), 63.5% of patients (40 of 63) had COMPLETELY clear skin at week 16 against 1 of 21 on placebo, with PASI 90 at 83%; Phase 1 PK after a single 600mg dose kept drug levels above the effective trough for a full year, which is the once-yearly dosing case against today's every-8-to-12-week injections. Longer-term EVERLAST-A data are guided to 2H 2026, so the next readout is near-dated. Liquidity at 2026-06-30 is $1,125.6M — $268.5M cash and equivalents PLUS $857.1M of marketable securities — against no debt at all, so the company funds itself a long way without the market; a $500M at-the-market facility was registered 2026-08-27 (sales agreement amended 2026-08-21), which is CAPACITY, not a completed raise, and no sales under it are yet disclosed. The binding question is therefore what a ~$6.8B price already pays for a drug that has worked, not whether a de-rating is overdone — the overshoot twin's question does not apply to a name up 190% in six months. The $300M-$10B band answers where the fund HUNTS, not what it may hold or follow; this name sits inside the band but fails the screen's entry gates on their own terms (at the 2026-08-24 reference date it was down 9% from its 52w high against a 30% floor and 178 points AHEAD of IWM over 180d; it has fallen further since — $91.50 on 2026-09-09 is 21% below the $115.52 high, so the SNAPSHOT price on this page and the GATE figures are deliberately different as-ofs, and the name is drifting toward, but has not reached, the screen's own entry), which is the screen behaving correctly rather than a gap to route around. The cap band decides where the fund HUNTS, not what it may hold or follow, so absence from it is not a rejection — read the verdict, not the absence: last evaluated 2026-10-16-01: FAIL (g1_drawdown PASS · g2_idiosyncratic FAIL).

business_description.value: Oruka Therapeutics, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, focuses on developing novel monoclonal antibody therapeutics for psoriasis (PsO), and other inflammatory and immunology (I&I) indications. Its lead products include ORKA-001 that targets p19 subunit of interleukin-23, which is in phase 2a trial for the treatment of PsO; and ORKA-002 that targets interleukin-17A and interleukin-17F, which is in phase 2 trial for the treatment of PsO, psoriatic arthritis, and other conditions. The company also develops ORKA-003 for targeting an undisclosed pathway; and ORKA-021, a sequential combination regimen of ORKA-002 and ORKA-001. Oruka Therapeutics, Inc. is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.
